nodes.recap: chapter header + the banquet hall
nodes.text:
-------------------------------
|          CHAPTER 23          |
-------------------------------


$CThe banquet hall has nothing in common with anything
you have seen since Ayonn.##

That is saying something.# The table, very small relative
to the enormity of the room, stands at the foot of a wide staircase
carpeted in red.# Hundreds of lights nest in the crevices
of the stone walls, casting a warm diffuse glow,
and from the vaulted ceiling an enormous chandelier
of gems and gold lights the center of the room
like a controlled star.# Stone pillars rise from the polished floor
to take the shapes of colossi and unknown creatures
that seem to hold the richly decorated ceiling on their shoulders.##

You arrive still dreamstruck, the way you arrive
at everything in this city, and you look around
and say nothing, because nothing is adequate.##

Then Saberinne comes through, and everything else
stops mattering.##

She is wearing a green dress with a train that seems to you,
irrational as it is, like the dress of a bride.#
Earrings, a necklace that falls toward her collarbone.#
Her face radiant with a warmth she is not containing
because she has stopped trying to.##

$c<<I think... I know... I will not let this end.
I know this is impossible.# I know it anyway.>>$C##

$CShe feels the thought.# She smiles, and she sits down,
and the evening begins.##

nodes.recap: after dinner - the open terrace, the stars, telling them the plan

dialogues.precomment:
After dinner you climb a staircase to a second terrace, this one
open to the sky, the night around you mild and clear,
and you sit in the candlelight and look at the stars of Noi-Hert.##

Saberinne says, to all of you:
dialogues.line: There is something we need to tell you.

My coming here was no accident, in the end.#
There is a reason I was brought to this world,
and a reason the four of you have carried me safely this far.

As I told you this morning, the city is under siege.#
It had no hope of surviving,# if you had not come.

Our minds, Kriss's and mine, can merge, perfectly,
into a single entity.

replies.line: Ask what the two of you would become.
Ask what it would let you do.

dialogues.line: And what would we become?
dialogues.comment:
You ask it in front of all four of them,
and find that you do not much care that they hear you ask it.

dialogues.line: And what would that let us do?
dialogues.comment:
You ask the practical question, the one that is owed
to four people who have carried you this far
for practical reasons.

dialogues.line:
It would keep what makes each of us who we are,#
and yet be something else.# Something more.##

The power of two minds already vast would multiply
past measuring, enough, we believe, to turn the Hordes back
from the wall to the north.

Tomorrow, at dawn, we go into the elliptical hall
and join our minds.# All you need do is wait,# and trust us.
dialogues.comment:
You say it simply, the way you have learned to say
difficult things, and they listen.##

A silence.

dialogues.line: You've already decided, then.
dialogues.comment: It is not a question.

dialogues.line:
I understand that what passed between you two
has been something that goes beyond what I could imagine.
I believe it must be this way.
It won't be dangerous, will it?
dialogues.comment: You smile at him.

dialogues.line:
Like everything else, there are risks.
But they won't stop me, will they, Smiurl?
You're right.
dialogues.comment:
He says it, and bows his head.##

And then Theo stands and crosses to you in two steps
and closes his arms around you,
and briefly reorganizes your spine.

nodes.recap: Theo's farewell - reply, then Kriss's protest

dialogues.precomment:
He holds on for one second, two, then releases you
and takes one step back and looks at you
with the expression you know now as Theo's everything:
dialogues.line:
This is my farewell.#
I have a strange presentiment, boy.#
In case we should not meet again.
dialogues.comment: He says it flatly, in his way, and means every word.

replies.line: Answer at once, before the presentiment can land.
Let it land, and refuse it anyway.

dialogues.comment:
You answer him straight away, before the thing he has said
can find anywhere in you to settle,
the way a hand comes back from something hot.

You let it settle exactly where he meant it to,
and you hold it there a moment before you say anything,
because refusing it is the last thing you have left to give him.

dialogues.line: I assure you it isn't necessary...

nodes.recap: Corolla's farewell - reply about how Kriss receives it

dialogues.precomment:
Corolla does not wait.# With her voice slightly uneven,
which is a thing she will never acknowledge,
she throws her arms around your neck.
dialogues.line: We don't care!
dialogues.comment:
She holds you for a moment, then draws back slowly,
her hands lingering in yours.##

$R"Don't get hurt.# Understood?"$C she whispers against your ear.

replies.line: Hold her gaze and say nothing.
Let her be the one to step back.

dialogues.comment:
You hold her eyes, and for one unguarded instant
the composure cracks completely before she catches it,
chin lifting, jaw setting itself back into place.

You let her go at her own pace, and understand,
watching her chin come up and her eyes stay dry,
that this, for Corolla, is exactly as much as she has to give.

nodes.recap: Efeliah's farewell - reply about how Kriss meets her look

dialogues.precomment:
Efeliah looks at you for a long moment with that gaze
that has always seen more than it should
and held it without judgment.# Then she says:
dialogues.line:
Goodbye, Kriss.#
I don't know why, but I feel that Theo is right...

replies.line: Let the silence answer for you.

dialogues.comment:
You look back at her until she is the one who glances away,
something passing between you that needs no telepathy to read.

You say nothing, and she seems to prefer it that way,
as though the silence itself were the honest answer.

nodes.recap: Smiurl's farewell - reply, then Kriss's collective goodbye to all four

dialogues.precomment:
They have all spoken now,# moved without quite understanding why,
and that only makes it worse.##

Smiurl says nothing.# He launches himself at you
with enough force to nearly knock you over,
his arms around your neck, his skin
flooding a quiet and complicated pattern of light:
every color, none of them quite settling.##

When he comes back down to earth:
dialogues.line: We will never forget you.
dialogues.comment: He says it simply.

replies.line: Hug him back before he lets go.
Let him have this on his own terms.

dialogues.comment:
You catch him properly this time,# and for a moment
he glows so brightly you can feel the warmth of it.

You let him step back and will not look at him either,
because he has decided this is not going to be harder than it must be,
and you owe him that much.

dialogues.line: Neither will I.# Not any of you.
dialogues.comment:
You embrace them all one last time,
and then they go to their rooms,
heart-heavy in ways none of you have quite named.##

You and Saberinne walk away arm in arm,
and she is quieting, gently, the storm that farewell has stirred in you.

nodes.recap: Kriss and Saberinne alone - the last night - one reply about the secret

dialogues.precomment:
After a while you find a small pavilion at the corner
of the open terrace, sheltered from other eyes
by a curve of the stonework, open only to the sky.#
You sit together on a narrow bench in the dark,
and for once you reach for actual words
rather than the silent kind.
dialogues.line: Do you think I'll really never see them again?
Who can say, Kriss?# Some things truly cannot be predicted.

For the first time since I've known you,
I have the feeling you are not telling me everything.
Doesn't everyone enjoy their small secrets?
dialogues.comment: She looks at the stars.# Then:

dialogues.line: And if it were a surprise?

replies.line: Tell her she could not keep it from you for long.
Tell her not to say it. Not tonight.

dialogues.line: I don't think you could hide it from me for long.
dialogues.comment:
She smiles at that, and does not deny it,
and does not tell you either.

dialogues.line: Then don't tell me.# Not tonight.
dialogues.comment:
You leave her the one thing she has asked to keep,
and she is quiet a moment, and you feel her take it.

dialogues.precomment: She rests her head on your shoulder.
dialogues.line:
Time will bring you answers when it brings tomorrow.##

Tomorrow we have a great mission, an appointment with destiny.
Better not to think about it too much.
dialogues.comment: She sighs, quietly.

dialogues.line: The night is so brief...
dialogues.comment: She turns to look at you.

dialogues.line:
And if your companions were right?#
And if this were our last night?
dialogues.comment: Her words dissolve in the silence between you.

dialogues.line:
We can no longer exist separately, Saberinne.
Nothing will separate me from you, or you from me,
not even our own separate wills.# You know this.
Of course, my love.# Of course.
dialogues.comment:
You look at each other for a long moment,
and then everything around you seems to dissolve
when she ends every question, every doubt,
and closes her mouth over yours.##

The stars fade.# The first red light of the sun
finds you still together, asleep, not letting go.

nodes.recap: dawn - the companions give them space - into the elliptical hall
nodes.text:
The companions understood, without being told,
that you and Saberinne would need complete concentration
and solitude.# They gather in one room,
asking each other what the outcome will be,
and whether they will truly see you again.##

You and Saberinne are ready.##

You enter the elliptical hall together, silent,
and walk to its center.# Then you separate,
moving in mirror-image to each of the two focal points
of the ellipse, and kneel,
hands resting on your thighs.##

You look at each other across the polished marble
one last time with your individual eyes.##

Then you open your minds to each other,
more deeply, more completely, than even in the garden.##

nodes.recap: the mind-merge - Surge instance 5, the duet with Saberinne (unfailable)
nodes.text:
Space and time lose part of their meaning.##

You perceive your bodies as if from outside them.
You are several meters apart and yet you can feel
each other's touch.# You let go of every resistance,
every tension, every individual thread.##

You see your minds as an indescribable tapestry
of light and sound and thought.#
You concentrate on that perception, forgetting your bodies,
forgetting the elliptical hall, forgetting the city,
forgetting the planet.##

Your thoughts, your memories, your sensations, your souls:
they mix, they merge, they become a single thing.##

It is no longer Saberinne.# It is no longer Kriss.##

Something reaches for the rest of itself, and finds it waiting.

challenge.successmessage:
That enormous power lifts toward the sky,
extending in every direction,
aware of every house, every person, every blade of grass,
every molecule of the valley.##

Below it the whole planet pulses like an enormous heart,
transmitting an unimaginable energy upward.##

Invisible, it extends over the city, then reaches north,
where so many small men are certain that this is the decisive assault,
the one that will deliver the city into their hands.#
They do not know they are transparent under the eye
of something they could not begin to conceive.##

For only a moment it hesitates.#
Then, exercising nothing more than its will, it begins.

nodes.recap: army step 1 - the panic; DECISION: how closely the entity looks, which decides which rendering of the archers (101/102) plays
nodes.text:
The deepest and most total panic floods the minds
of most of the attackers at once.# They run in every direction,
smashing into each other, trampling each other,
two companions turning suddenly to fight each other
without understanding why.##

It arrives in you as your own nerve endings firing,
small terrors past counting lit in the same instant,
and the thing you have become discovers that it must settle
one question before it acts again:# how closely it intends
to look at what it is doing.

choices.desc: Keep hold of them singly, and know what each one feels.
Take them in as one mass, and do not look closer.

nodes.recap: the archers, rendered close: one man, known individually
nodes.text:
You hold them one at a time, and so you are there for it
when the arrows go up:# there inside the man who understands,
a half-second too late, that the shapes his volley is falling
among are not the city's sparse defenders but his own allies,
who turn on him now, furious, and do not listen.##

You know his name.# You are going to go on knowing it.

nodes.recap: the archers, rendered distant: a movement across a surface
nodes.text:
You take them as a single surface, and the archers are
no more than a movement across it:# a volley loosed,
falling among their own allies, and the furious turning
that answers it, begun and finished before any one
of those minds has the time to become a person to you.##

That, you understand, is the point of holding them this way.

nodes.recap: army step 2 - firearms explode or lose their charge, the army comes apart
nodes.text:
Every firearm explodes in its holster.#
Energy weapons lose their charge, sucked dry
by an invisible force.##

The army has come apart, and is fleeing,
though some among them still resist.

nodes.recap: army step 3 - the southern wind, red clouds, lightning, the devastated plain
nodes.text:
Then a wind rises from the south, driving a wall of clouds
the color of a sick, rusty red, and behind them come
lightning storms that scorch the ground in multiple places
where the forest once stood.##

Transport vehicles explode, catch fire.# Horses bolt,
as panicked as their riders.##

The plain north of the city is devastation now:
fires, the fallen, swarms of soldiers running
without direction or comprehension.# Chaos absolute.

nodes.recap: army step 4 - the final impulse; DECISION: whether the entity watches its own act (131/132), which changes nothing it does
nodes.text:
At that sight, something in what is left of you stirs,
and with one last impulse you gather yourself
to sweep the ruin from in front of you.##

It takes a moment to arrive.# You have that moment,
and nothing to spend it on but the question
of whether you mean to be present for what comes next.

choices.desc: Hold your attention on them while it happens.
Turn your attention away and let it be done.

nodes.recap: the impulse, watched
nodes.text:
You stay, and you spare yourself none of it.#
Whatever you carry out of that hall afterwards,
it is not going to be the comfort of not having seen.

nodes.recap: the impulse, unwatched - and the not-watching changes nothing
nodes.text:
You turn away inside yourself, the way you would close
a hand over an eye, and the act goes forward regardless,
as exact and as complete as it would have been.##

The not-looking costs it nothing, and spares you nothing,
and you know both of those things while you do it.

nodes.recap: army step 5 - the black vortex sweeps the army away
nodes.text:
An enormous black vortex descends from the clouds,
bending every remaining tree before it as it passes.#
Everything in its path is dragged upward into its coils,
implacable, not distinguishing.# The greater part of that army
is lifted from the ground like sand.##

It is a terrifying sight.# Almost no one on the city walls
has the courage to watch it.##

The vortex moves north and disappears over the horizon,
carrying an entire army with it, taking them,
if any survive, to the most remote land on the planet.

nodes.recap: aftermath - survivors and the legend - Elder Long feels the pulse
nodes.text:
Those few who fled first through the forest escape,
and they reach their ships and drive them at full speed
for days, dispersing into the ocean, making landfall
finally on the northern continent.# And those survivors
will carry the memory of the terror of Saberinne
to every corner of the world,
and a legend will be born from what they witnessed.##

At his rock far away in the desert,
Elder Long perceives the pulse of that enormous energy
and is shaken by it, even from that distance.

nodes.recap: the merge ends - separation - friends' vision restored - the irreversible truth

dialogues.precomment:
Done.##

The city is safe.# Gradually, the immense energies are released,
and it diminishes, withdraws, folding back toward the hall
where two bodies breathe quietly, waiting.##

Slowly, with an immense pain that passes through them
to the smallest fiber of their being, they begin to separate.#
Their thoughts divide, their perception diverges,
and they fall back, each toward their own body.##

You feel yourself returning, on the edge of opening your eyes,
when a new surge of energy engulfs you.

dialogues.line: What is happening?!
dialogues.comment: You cry it without making any sound.

dialogues.line: Kriss, you do not belong to this world.# This is not your universe.
I don't understand.

The process is now irreversible.#
We would not have had a second attempt.
What are you talking about?

Our joined effort can carry you back to your universe of origin.
We drew on tremendous energies, and they can give you
the push you need.
But I don't want to go back.
dialogues.comment: Great pain in those five words.

dialogues.line:
Kriss, you must.# This is your world, not that one...#
Don't think it is easy for me.# You know exactly what I feel.
dialogues.comment:
And you do.# Her mind is open to you,
and her pain is your pain, exact and equal.

dialogues.precomment:
You think of your companions, and see them,
all of them, in that one room, worrying over what has become of you.##

They had been right.# You will surely never see them again.##

Saberinne lets you see it: what is in their minds, right now,
as if it were your own.##

Corolla considers you a brother, and you understand at last
the contradiction that has run through her these last days:
how she could approve what you chose to do
and still, at the same time, want only to protect you from it.##

Theo, loyal and immovable as rock, has fixed your image
in that enormous heart of his, next to the small one
he keeps for Smiurl.##

Efeliah, dear friend, is saying goodbye to you even now,
and you answer the touch in her mind, which flares at once,
bright as a struck match.##

And inside that same mind, Saberinne plants something else:
a thought, the shape of a thing to come.# You see Efeliah,
years from now, leading the city, raising with Math
a projector greater than anything Ayonn ever built.
dialogues.line: Why?
dialogues.comment: You ask it, and Saberinne does not answer in words.

replies.line: Go looking in her mind for the reason.
Ask nothing more, and let it come or not.

dialogues.comment:
You go looking, and she does not stop you,
and what you find is not a reason so much as a preparation:
the city put into hands that will still be holding it
long after hers have let go of it.

You ask nothing further.# It reaches you anyway, unoffered,
the way her pain reaches you:# the city put into hands
that will still be holding it long after hers have let go of it.

dialogues.line:
The same risks you run, I run.#
There is a possibility that one of us, or both,
could be lost in the continuum, stranded between two dimensions,
or in another parallel universe entirely...
dialogues.comment: You cannot lose each other.

dialogues.line: We cannot lose each other.# I won't survive you.
Nor I you.
dialogues.comment: She says it with the same note in her voice.

dialogues.line:
But this sacrifice is necessary.#
Do you remember what you said to me last night?#
Nothing can separate us.# Keep this with you always:#
we will be united, wherever in space and time
we find ourselves, across any distance, across any universe.

dialogues.precomment:
$W"And now, with that knowledge in our hearts,
we throw ourselves toward this unknown
and hope that all will be well."$C##

You say it together, both of you,
in one voice and not without fear.

dialogues.line: I will not forget you.# I will not let you go.# Never.
Never.
dialogues.comment:
Weeping without tears, you vanish in a blinding flash of light.##

The translucent drapes of the elliptical hall
are blasted to dust.# A strong wind
runs through the city of Saberinne.##

The echo of that explosion of grief
circles the planet multiple times,
and drowns, in its intensity and passion,
every other emotion in the entire solar system of Noi-Hert.
